title: Getting started with condepe
text: condepe_series() filters source indicator , optionally, IBGE code (7 digits municipalities, "26" State) year. population Recife (2611606): Look codes condepe_localities():
code: recife <- condepe_series(   "sidra_populacao_estimada", "Populacao residente estimada",   code = "2611606", years = 2015:2026 ) recife[, c("nm_municipio", "ano", "valor", "unidade")] #> # A tibble: 10 × 4 #>    nm_municipio   ano   valor unidade #>    <chr>        <int>   <dbl> <chr>   #>  1 Recife        2015 1617183 Pessoas #>  2 Recife        2016 1625583 Pessoas #>  3 Recife        2017 1633697 Pessoas #>  4 Recife        2018 1637834 Pessoas #>  5 Recife        2019 1645727 Pessoas #>  6 Recife        2020 1653461 Pessoas #>  7 Recife        2021 1661017 Pessoas #>  8 Recife        2024 1587707 Pessoas #>  9 Recife        2025 1588376 Pessoas #> 10 Recife        2026 1588983 Pessoas loc <- condepe_localities() loc[grepl("Petrolina|Caruaru", loc$nm_municipio), ] #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   cd_municipio_ibge nm_municipio #>   <chr>             <chr>        #> 1 2604106           Caruaru      #> 2 2611101           Petrolina

title: Getting started with condepe
text: Monthly sources carry period twice: mes, full label indicador ("... [MM/YYYY]"). Filter indicador_base, label without period:
code: suape <- condepe_series(   "porto_suape_carga", "Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total",   years = 2026 ) suape[, c("ano", "mes", "indicador", "valor", "unidade")] #> # A tibble: 9 × 5 #>     ano   mes indicador                                       valor unidade #>   <int> <int> <chr>                                           <dbl> <chr>   #> 1  2026     1 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [01/2026] 2193515. t       #> 2  2026     2 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [02/2026] 2084475. t       #> 3  2026     3 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [03/2026] 2223492. t       #> 4  2026     4 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [04/2026] 2360768. t       #> 5  2026     5 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [05/2026] 2403538. t       #> 6  2026     6 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [06/2026] 2445490. t       #> 7  2026     7 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [07/2026] 2363978. t       #> 8  2026     8 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [08/2026] 2726020. t       #> 9  2026     9 Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total [09/2026] 2453353. t

title: Getting started with condepe
text: condepe_data() returns source full. 15 columns keep Portuguese names Observatory publishes , result can always traced back official files: missing value never becomes zero: original source publish simply absent.
code: nasc <- condepe_data("datasus_sinasc") names(nasc) #>  [1] "cd_municipio_ibge" "nm_municipio"      "ano"               #>  [4] "mes"               "indicador"         "indicador_base"    #>  [7] "valor"             "unidade"           "natureza"          #> [10] "id_fonte"          "eixo"              "tema"              #> [13] "assunto"           "fonte_original"    "arquivo_origem"

title: Getting started with condepe
text: Files downloaded per catalogue version kept condepe_cache_dir(), checked SHA-256 published catalogue; new version comes , old files dropped. catalogue trusted six hours (refresh = TRUE asks ). Data come canonical endpoint, https://cf.pe.gov.br/observatorio/dados/atual/. answer, package reads files Hugging Face mirror mlkwy/observatorio-pernambuco. neither answers, functions warn return zero-row tibbles documented columns, scripts degrade instead breaking.

what: Infant mortality in the largest cities
title: Worked examples
text: Infant mortality (deaths one year per thousand live births, municipality residence) Recife, Jaboatão dos Guararapes, Caruaru Petrolina:
code: cidades <- c(   Recife = "2611606", Jaboatao = "2607901",   Caruaru = "2604106", Petrolina = "2611101" ) tmi <- condepe_series(   "datasus_mortalidade_infantil",   "Taxa de mortalidade infantil (por mil nascidos vivos)",   code = cidades ) largo <- reshape(   as.data.frame(tmi[, c("nm_municipio", "ano", "valor")]),   idvar = "ano", timevar = "nm_municipio", direction = "wide" ) largo #>    ano valor.Caruaru valor.Jaboatão dos Guararapes valor.Petrolina valor.Recife #> 1 2017         11.98                         10.63           15.30        10.83 #> 2 2018         10.73                         12.08           15.20        10.53 #> 3 2019          9.62                         11.59           18.07        11.50 #> 4 2020          9.74                         12.19           14.02        11.20 #> 5 2021         10.62                         12.12           15.40        10.03 #> 6 2022         13.17                         13.96           14.86        10.93 #> 7 2023         12.64                         13.41           14.28        12.32 #> 8 2024         11.35                         13.87           16.36        11.85 cores <- c("#0c2856", "#0068ff", "#00b7ff", "#ff6700") matplot(   largo$ano, largo[, -1], type = "b", pch = 19, lty = 1, col = cores,   xlab = "", ylab = "per 1,000 live births", main = "Infant mortality",   ylim = c(8, 22) ) legend("top", sub("valor.", "", names(largo)[-1]), ncol = 2,        col = cores, lty = 1, pch = 19, bty = "n", cex = 0.9)

what: Cargo at the port of Suape
title: Worked examples
text: Monthly gross cargo handled Suape (Ipojuca), million tonnes:
code: suape <- condepe_series("porto_suape_carga", "Porto de Suape - Carga bruta total") suape$data <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", suape$ano, suape$mes)) plot(   suape$data, suape$valor / 1e6, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#0c2856",   xlab = "", ylab = "million t", main = "Port of Suape, gross cargo" )

title: condepe: Access the Open Data of the Pernambuco Observatory — condepe-package
text: tidy interface open data Observatory Pernambuco, Brazil, published 'Condepe/Fidem', State Agency Planning Research (https://cf.pe.gov.br/observatorio). Municipal series population, economy, public finance, labour, education, health, security, transport environment, every source long format, returned tibbles. Files read canonical endpoint 'Hugging Face' mirror fallback, cached disk per catalogue version checked published 'SHA-256'. Network failures handled gracefully.

title: condepe: Access the Open Data of the Pernambuco Observatory — condepe-package
text: condepe.quiet: suppress informational messages. Defaults TRUE non-interactive sessions. condepe.cache_dir: cache location. Defaults tools::R_user_dir("condepe", "cache"). condepe.catalog_max_age: seconds cached catalogue trusted without asking server. Defaults 6 hours. condepe.base_url, condepe.mirror_url: canonical endpoint mirror (also CONDEPE_URL / CONDEPE_MIRROR_URL); empty mirror disables fallback. condepe.max_tries, condepe.timeout: retry attempts (default 3, exponential backoff) request timeout seconds (default 60).
